Looking at the examples, let me identify patterns:

- History: prices have been rising, with a spike recently
- Model forecasts are too LOW, especially at farther horizons
- At horizon 0: model 66.34 vs true 66.42 (under by 0.08)
- At horizon 10: model 70.56 vs true 71.17 (under by 0.61)
- At horizon 20: model 66.47 vs true 71.49 (under by 5.02) - this is very different!
